rendered: Durability at the high rate: at cycle 1500[1] the cathode, cycled at 1C[2], delivered 306 mAh/gS[3] (per gram of sulfur). The rate test at 1C[4] showed a reversible capacity of 370 mAh/gS[5]. The cycle-1500[6] capacity is therefore 82.7[7] percent of that rate-test reversible capacity.
